referenceFunction.generalComment: Datasets established on tha basis of the modelling for CH. Difference is Chinese electricity mix, own assumption for distance travelled by spent fuel and steel using CN (coal) freight train transport.This plant is hypothesized at the same site of the repository. As first approximation the welding of lid and bottom of the canister is described with the ecoinvent module with double lenght. Electricity use is estimated hypothesizing 50 m total movement of the canister within the plant. The total spent fuel to condition is assumed to be 1800 t heavy metal, complying with the current (around 2003) Swiss scenario. This dataset has been developed with the goal to serve a preliminary estimation of the Chinese nuclear chain for the Chinese electricity mix. Hence, it cannot be used for comparisons of conditioning among countries.; UUID: 9f3109af-60a7-4281-b05c-cf39141d0fe9
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: It includes transport of spent fuel elements and steel for canister, requirement of steel for canisters, steel welding, electricity consumption, and infrastructure requirement.
